residuals.name: explicit graph taxonomy and full-scope freeze closure
residuals.counterexample: A design obligation in an API/failure facet is absent from the declared catalog, while every declared edge and oracle is closed; generic catalog closure can report complete without a fixed FR42 facet inventory unless every applicable source/requirement atom is first bound to the required facet set.
residuals.candidate_condition_outline: For the target scope, enumerate each source/requirement atom's required capability/service, domain-object and API/data/state/event/failure/security/observability/lifecycle/operation/test-oracle/gate correspondences; individualize every missing/orphan/placeholder/unsupported-N/A/aggregate-discharge finding and block pair-freeze eligible while any applicable obligation remains open. Preserve unknown when applicability or source is unselected.

residuals.name: 13-field requirement definition schema and operation-bound change receipt
residuals.counterexample: A row with source span, owner and semantic digest but without priority or requirement kind can pass a generic declared-edge closure; or a split is applied while its receipt omits one before/after semantic digest or a source atom disposition, with no operation-specific receipt oracle to block application.
residuals.candidate_condition_outline: Represent each of the 13 legacy fields as typed per-revision data/edges and validate them individually; for FR45-targeted split/merge/rename/supersede/reject/N/A changes, require one operation-bound receipt containing before/after semantic digests, disposition for every source atom, downstream stale range and review authority. Preserve the adopted HIL-FR-53 identity-lineage conditions without broadening them or duplicating them. Do not create a new approval process; use the existing authority decision boundary.
